tagline: Be who you are, and be that well.

spine.note: 366, not 365 x 1 as spec's table states — see sourceNote and portals-spec.md discussion. Maps 1:1 onto a leap year; common years merge the last two entries onto Dec 31 (mirrors Benedict's own leap-day handling, common/leap roles swapped).
